methodology.comparison: Sequential by credential. Compare official exam facts with the live exam facts card and section weights when accessible, plus the corresponding repository data. methodology.releaseStatus: Website corrections verified in the local production build. Live website values in this file were captured before changes.
methodology.changes: Individual correction entries and before/after repository data are keyed by siteSlug. The source URL for each official figure is on the corresponding Academy or guide record.
